response.justification: While Bogdan is a talented and experienced software engineer with strong general development skills, he lacks critical qualifications for this role. Most critically, there is no evidence of native-level Japanese language proficiency, which is an explicit required qualification. His career has focused primarily on web and backend development with minimal C programming experience (only 6 months at National Instruments), while the role demands strong C proficiency for embedded UNIX systems development. He also completely lacks domain expertise in embedded networking, security technologies (MACsec, IEEE 802.1X, device attack detection), Linux kernel investigation, and LAN switch products—all fundamental to this security-focused embedded networking position.
strengths: Extensive software development experience (14+ years) with proven ability to deliver complex systems and master diverse technical domains
Strong track record in software craftsmanship, testing practices, CI/CD implementation, and cross-functional team collaboration
Demonstrates technical versatility and continuous learning by working across multiple programming languages and platforms
concerns: No evidence of native-level Japanese language proficiency, a required qualification for this role
Career focused on JavaScript/TypeScript and web backend; only 6 months of C/C++ experience despite role requiring strong C proficiency for embedded UNIX development
No demonstrated experience with embedded networking, security technologies (encryption, authentication, attack detection), Linux kernel analysis, or network switch products

key_factors.factor: Insufficient C Programming Experience for Embedded UNIX
